entries.partTitle: Redis Cluster Architecture: CRC16 Hash Slot Sharding & Hash Tags

left.title: Standalone Redis Node
items: Single threaded process bound to memory limits.
No horizontal partitioning across shards.
Lacks automated slot distribution mechanisms.

right.title: Redis Clustered Tier
items: Sixteen thousand logical hash slots.
Even distribution across primary shards.
Hash tags enforce co-located multi-key slots.

entries.partTitle: Memory Management & Eviction Policies: allkeys-lru, volatile-lru & OOM Defense

left.title: Unbounded Noeviction
items: Rejects write commands when memory reaches capacity.
Throws disruptive out of memory errors.
Causes cascading microservice downtime.

right.title: Configured Eviction
items: Least recently used keys evicted dynamically.
Frequently accessed working set stays resident.
Reserved memory buffers background replication.

entries.partTitle: Caching Topologies: Cache-Aside (Lazy Loading) vs. Write-Through & Write-Back

left.title: Cache-Aside Pattern
items: Reads query cache first then fall back to database.
Only requested active data resides in memory.
Potential for data staleness until expiration.

right.title: Write-Through Pattern
items: Simultaneously writes to cache and database.
Guarantees absolute freshness on subsequent reads.
Higher write latency across dual storage layers.

entries.partTitle: Cache Stampede & Thundering Herd Defense: Mutex Locking & Probabilistic Early Expiration

left.title: Unprotected Stampede
items: Expired hot keys trigger simultaneous misses.
Thousands of concurrent queries hit database.
Connection pools exhaust causing outages.

right.title: Mutex Lock Defense
items: First thread acquires atomic distributed lock.
Single query computes fresh cache value.
Remaining threads read cached results or fallback.
